gold: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum in situ (SCACPIS) arising in a precursor lesion of syringocystadenoma papilliferum (SCAP) with macular amyloidosis
e7_s4_rationale: The histopathological examination revealed a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining and multiple papillary projections, which is consistent with Hidradenoma papilliferum. The presence of p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers also supports this diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The lack of dermal invasion and the presence of a well-defined tumor with apocrine epithelial lining suggests a benign lesion, making Apocrine gland carcinoma less likely.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum
e7_s4_rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely due to the absence of syringomatous features and the presence of a well-defined tumor with apocrine epithelial lining.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cylindrocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The histopathological features do not match those of Cylindrocarcinoma, which typically shows a more aggressive and infiltrative growth pattern.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Apocrine adenocarcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The lack of dermal invasion and the presence of a well-defined tumor with apocrine epithelial lining suggests a benign lesion, making Apocrine adenocarcinoma less likely.
